census_field_selection.rule: >= 20000 records, cap 40 heaviest, plus five V5-proposal fields

panel_path: .staging_sec_v6/multivintage_panel.jsonl (GITIGNORED; raw panel bytes are never committed)
pit_semantics: MULTI-VINTAGE: every filed vintage is retained; a decision at t may observe the latest vintage with avail < gate(t) (plus optional age bound) - never the latest vintage in the store

row_schema.avail: availability date (SEC filed date; availability stamp = end of filed UTC day) YYYY-MM-DD
row_schema.evd: event date when it differs from effective
row_schema.s: sector tag of the frozen 410-filer panel
